chapters.label: Thirty seconds, live
chapters.text: Barcelona against Inter, a Champions League semi-final, April 2025. Thirty seconds gone! Dumfries races down the right and crosses twice. Marcus Thuram, six yards out and facing the wrong way, flicks it in with his heel!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. His back is to the goal, but one flick of the heel beats the keeper.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His big weapon is the powerful run in behind. Watch how he does it: body between defender and ball, then drive!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: use your body to hold off the defender while you drive towards goal!
